status: exploratory; specified before this export validation; historical periods already examined

bank.eligibility: original finite target block and two endpoints; no concentration threshold
bank.sampling: separate nonoverlapping candidate windows per length and geometry, stride=max(288,length+72), season-stratified seeded round robin; overlap between lengths/geometry allowed and reported
bank.boundary_concealment: leading masks all target context before hidden block; trailing masks all target context after block; neighbor channels remain original unless none arm

models.network_inputs: only raw other-station pm25 and availability plus calendar; target and own meteorology excluded
models.common_inputs: existing common_features on target-permuted original four channels with whole target gap concealed
models.augmentation: actual and all-neighbors-missing copies; only original observed targets

selection.criterion: pooled raw squared error per station/length/regime on selection only; ties follow listed order
selection.length_assignment: smallest evaluated internal length >= natural run length, at most720
selection.fallback: choose per station/regime by pooled selection error on leading/trailing720; if unavailable use pooled internal720; if fewer8 blocks use climatology
selection.deploy_refit: after frozen evaluation, fit same fixed models on all original observed2019-2022; no imputed labels or neighbors

smoothing.interpretation: fixed design parameters; sensitivity reported; not estimated noise variance or optimal physical denoising

interpretation.clock: unchanged naive raw clock; timezone unknown
interpretation.units: raw numeric export units; provisionally common ug/m3, unconfirmed
interpretation.intervals: none: no calibrated natural-gap prediction interval
interpretation.support: artificial_mask_evaluated denotes test design coverage only, not natural-gap accuracy
interpretation.leading: before first original target observation; installation date not inferred
interpretation.adr: use original observations and mask; filled/smoothed values do not add independent information
